If you fill up #b#e#t4220186##n#k with Bowman's energy, you will obtain the #r#eHOT ITEM#k, #t1112740##n, that all Bowmen MUST have.

yes.0: You've made the right choice! Fill up this #b#t4220186##k with Bowman's energy to get your prize. Here's how...
